Title: Generally available: New learning content on the Azure IoT Central homepage

Body.Content:
Explore learning resources such as architecture diagrams, documentation, and videos on the updated Azure IoT Central homepage. Information is organized by key workflows (connect, manage, analyze, secure, extend) and this structure is repeated across the navigation menu and documentation so you can focus on the part of the solution building journey that you are in. The home page also links to common questions such as “Why start with Azure IoT Central?” to make information easier to find.

See the new home page here.
